method: Four coordinate-labelled pixel controls from flat Google map, roof rectangle ratios, shared neighbour datum and facade proportions. Estimates, not survey.

plan.calculation: Front vector approximately 9.57 m; rear vector 9.66 m; depth approximately 11.08 m. Adopt frontage 9.67 m (existing shared width) and depth 11.10 m. Absolute roof edge projects about 2 m away from current neighbour datum; do not treat roof coordinate as ground survey.

front.method: Rectified composition from archive drawing cross-checked against current oblique photograph. Shared lower balcony level aligns neighbouring 3–9 first windows; five upper centres spread across flat 8.87 m wall.

roof.basis: Close 48 m Google 3D orbit in four directions and overhead pixel calibration. Estimated, not roof survey.

close_plan.method: Affine basis from front south to front north (9.67 m), and front south to rear south (11.1 m).

registration.basis: Exact terminal frontage datum of neighbouring 3–9 Nevill. Shared affine shear retained.
